title: GPT-5 leaked details: what we know about OpenAI's next model

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: GPT-5 isn't just an upgrade—it's a leap in reasoning, code generation, and multilingual fluency. OpenAI’s roadmap is clear and rigorous.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Leaked details show major security flaws and training data biases—OpenAI isn’t being transparent about real risks.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The leaks are incomplete and misinterpreted. GPT-5 uses red-teaming protocols and safer alignment techniques than any prior model.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: If OpenAI isn’t disclosing these flaws, how can we trust their safety measures or the model’s real-world impact?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Leaked info is the only way to hold them accountable—no model is perfect, but secrecy isn’t a solution.
